build_boxnet_model: build a BoxNet model for 3D object detection on point clouds with configurable classes and proposals
run_boxnet_forward: run a forward pass of BoxNet on a point cloud tensor to get detection end points
test_boxnet_inference: test BoxNet inference by passing a point cloud dict and printing all end point keys
review_boxnet_forward: review the BoxNet forward method to understand how backbone features feed into the proposal module
summarize_boxnet_init: summarize the BoxNet constructor parameters including num_class, num_heading_bin, num_size_cluster, and mean_size_arr
